theme: An open calendar, a stack of trip decisions to make from the boat.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar and the girls are with Jen, Dan — but the fall trip is piling up bookings, and you're deciding them from a charter with thin signal. Clear the shore errands while the connection holds.

needsAttention.title: Swap the St Pete Airbnb before it charges
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking (~$2,331) charges tomorrow, Sept 18. Today is the last clean window to switch for a better price or spot before it's locked.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still open for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The hotel's booked, but the Komolac–Cavtat transfer, an early bag hold, and a ~5:15 AM checkout for the Sept 20 flight all need arranging from shore before the charter's signal drops.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the Sept 20 landing
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday Sept 20 at 3:55 PM — the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV is no longer a hedge. Book it now so you're not at walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Two nights in St Pete, Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: You land Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Tue Sept 22 — the two landing nights before the Orlando villa are still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV from PWM over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. Hold a refundable one now and tune the dates later.

flagged.title: Claudia Kruse messaged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn message from three days ago is still unread — worth a reply while the board search is active.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto autumn conference
flagged.detail: A registration reminder for the ICGN governance conference in Toronto landed Monday.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions — Breeze and Virgin points, Mandarin Oriental, skincare, and the language-of-the-day newsletters.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Buy the Disney tickets for the Sept 26–27 weekend

acts.line: An empty calendar to open the day — the shore hours are unclaimed.
The open stretch holds; nothing is scheduled against you.
A quiet close with the girls at Jen's — the evening is your own.
